demo.mp4.shows: The sweep the judge graded, in five moving shots cut on black: (1) one pass per scenario, a playhead sweeping the 100 years while the measured volume fills in behind it and the 50 %-crossing marker pops; (2) zoomed crossings, the 50 % rule line sweeping down and locking each measured year in; (3) the judge's shape gate drawn live against the +-2 % band; (4) the self-test kill matrix scanned row by row (13/13); (5) a static end card with the verdict. 26.2 s, 30 fps, 1920x1080, H.264 (-crf 18). A lossless master (-crf 0) is written to media/master/ (git-ignored).

loop.png.shows: Agent loop and self-test. Left: gates still failing per iteration of a real fix sequence (data/loop/iter1..5, each graded by judge/grade.sh); the label is the gate the judge failed that iteration on (artifact -> zero_melt -> final_volume -> figure -> PASS). Right: the self-test kill matrix, known-good vs the 13 single-edit mutants, each row the gate that killed it.

result.png.shows: Key figure. Left: the three scenario volume curves from the judge's own run of examples/good (solid) against the analytic oracle V_exact(t) (dashed), the 50 %-of-V(0) crossing rule line, and each measured crossing year. Right: the shape gate's measured deviation from the analytic volume at every year against the +-2 % pass band; the band is the pass line. Worst deviation 0.38 %.
